completion_decisions: Reconstruct Algorithms 1-3 directly from the CC-BY paper with counter-keyed shuffle and declared deterministic tie handling.
Compile numeric paper-linked data with source revisions and hashes while implementing all equations independently.
Use repository-consistent equation recalculation rather than stale embedded DEBO AEP metadata.
Parallelize candidates at each DEBO decision and preserve ordered state commits; use direction parallelism only for standalone fixed-layout evaluation.
missing_information: software license file in the paper-linked GitHub repository

paper.authors: Jared J. Thomas and Nicholas F. Baker and Paul Malisani and Erik Quaeghebeur and Sebastian Sanchez Perez-Moreno and John Jasa and Christopher Bay and Federico Tilli and David Bieniek and Nick Robinson and Andrew P. J. Stanley and Wesley Holt and Andrew Ning
paper.title: A Comparison of Eight Optimization Methods Applied to a Wind Farm Layout Optimization Problem

paper_source_conflicts: The paper-linked repository provides evaluator and result assets but no executable DEBO optimizer or exact shuffle implementation.
The repository has no license file, so production code independently implements paper equations and copies no author optimizer code.
The Python evaluator header says case study 3 although the loaded assets and paper are case study 4.
The DEBO YAML embeds 2861182.50569 MWh, but repository-consistent recalculation gives 2913220.60417 MWh and matches the paper's 2913.221 GWh.
Rounded baseline coordinates accumulate 1.130514 m polygon residual.

scope.claim_boundary: paper-equation and paper-linked-data academic declared reproduction; DEBO is independently reconstructed because executable author DEBO code is absent

constraints_and_repair.resolution: inside any of five polygons and at least 396 m inter-turbine distance; only feasible DEBO candidates are evaluated

decision_variables.resolution: ordered sequence of 81 continuous turbine coordinates within five disconnected regions

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: 100 m admissible grid for greedy allocation followed by progressively refined discrete neighborhoods

initialization.resolution: upper-right first point, boundary-first potential set, then sequential best-AEP greedy allocation with a no-border fallback

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: AEP, wake loss, feasibility, physical FES, stage timings, scientific hash, paper result-layout oracle, and 25 platform seeds

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize annual energy production and report wake-loss fraction

paper_native_cases.resolution: IEA Task 37 case study 4 based on Borssele III and IV, 81 turbines and five disconnected regions

parameters.resolution: dx=dy=100 m, dmin=396 m, dmax=990 m, L=1000 m, Lmin=5 m, ns=6, rho=0.75

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: greedy completion followed by local convergence at each L while L is greater than 5 m; every complete candidate AEP counts as one physical FES

update_order.resolution: counter-keyed Fisher-Yates turbine order, parallel candidate evaluation, strict-improvement and deterministic lexicographic ordered commits

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: simplified Bastankhah Gaussian wake, 8/9 thrust coefficient, 0.0324555 wake expansion, RSS deficits, and IEA 10 MW piecewise power curve

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 360 one-degree direction bins crossed with 20 direction-conditioned speed bins
